package practiceroute

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain/repository"
	domainservice "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain/service"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/usecase/pedagogy"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

type Clock interface{ Now() time.Time }

type Resolver struct {
	Routes     repository.PracticeLearningRouteRepository
	Readiness  repository.PracticeLearningReadinessRepository
	Catalog    repository.PracticeLearningCatalog
	Students   domainservice.PracticeStudentMasteryService
	Policies   repository.PolicyRepository
	Strategies pedagogy.Registry
	Clock      Clock
}

// ReconcileReadiness asks Student for current objective mastery and records
// Planner's decision for one exact, frozen route step. A repeated key replays
// the original receipt; a new key takes a new Student mastery snapshot.
func (resolver Resolver) ReconcileReadiness(
	ctx context.Context,
	idempotencyKey string,
	input domain.PracticeLearningReadinessRequestV1,
) (domain.PracticeLearningReadinessReceiptV1, bool, error) {
	if resolver.Routes == nil || resolver.Readiness == nil || resolver.Students == nil || resolver.Policies == nil || resolver.Clock == nil {
		return domain.PracticeLearningReadinessReceiptV1{}, false, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	normalized, err := domain.NormalizePracticeLearningReadinessRequest(input)
	if err != nil || idempotencyKey != strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(idempotencyKey)) || !validUUID(idempotencyKey) {
		return domain.PracticeLearningReadinessReceiptV1{}, false, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	requestHash, err := digestJSON(normalized)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.PracticeLearningReadinessReceiptV1{}, false, err
	}
	existing, err := resolver.Readiness.GetByIdempotencyKey(ctx, normalized.TaskInstanceID, normalized.StepID, idempotencyKey)
	if err == nil {
		if existing.RequestHash != requestHash || existing.IdempotencyKey != idempotencyKey {
			return domain.PracticeLearningReadinessReceiptV1{}, false, domain.ErrConflict
		}
		return existing.Receipt, false, nil
	}
	if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
		return domain.PracticeLearningReadinessReceiptV1{}, false, err
	}

	routeRecord, err := resolver.Routes.GetByID(ctx, normalized.RouteID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.PracticeLearningReadinessReceiptV1{}, false, err
	}
	route := routeRecord.Route
	if route.TaskInstanceID != normalized.TaskInstanceID || route.StudentID != normalized.StudentID ||
		route.TaskRevisionID != normalized.TaskRevisionID || route.TaskRevisionDigest != normalized.TaskRevisionDigest ||
		route.ID != normalized.RouteID || route.RouteDigest != normalized.RouteDigest {
		return domain.PracticeLearningReadinessReceiptV1{}, false, domain.ErrConflict
	}
	computedRouteDigest, err := routeDigest(route)
	if err != nil || computedRouteDigest != route.RouteDigest {
		return domain.PracticeLearningReadinessReceiptV1{}, false, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	var step *domain.PracticeLearningRouteStep
	for index := range route.Steps {
		if route.Steps[index].StepID == normalized.StepID {
			step = &route.Steps[index]
			break
		}
	}
	if step == nil || len(step.Requirements) == 0 {
		return domain.PracticeLearningReadinessReceiptV1{}, false, domain.ErrNotFound
	}

	policy, err := resolver.Policies.GetActivePolicyBundle(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.PracticeLearningReadinessReceiptV1{}, false, err
	}
	policy, err = domain.NormalizePolicyBundle(policy)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.PracticeLearningReadinessReceiptV1{}, false, err
	}
	stepInput := domain.PracticeLearningStepInput{StepID: step.StepID}
	for _, requirement := range step.Requirements {
		stepInput.Requirements = append(stepInput.Requirements, domain.PracticeLearningRequirement{
			ID: requirement.ID, Target: requirement.Target, Policy: requirement.Policy, MasteryThreshold: requirement.MasteryThreshold,
		})
	}
	mastery, err := resolver.queryMastery(ctx, normalized.StudentID, uniqueRouteTargets([]domain.PracticeLearningStepInput{stepInput}))
	if err != nil {
		return domain.PracticeLearningReadinessReceiptV1{}, false, err
	}
	masteryByTarget, err := indexRouteMastery(uniqueRouteTargets([]domain.PracticeLearningStepInput{stepInput}), mastery)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.PracticeLearningReadinessReceiptV1{}, false, err
	}
	state := struct {
		RouteID string `json:"route_id"`
		StepID  string `json:"step_id"`
		Items   []any  `json:"requirements"`
	}{RouteID: route.ID, StepID: step.StepID, Items: make([]any, 0, len(step.Requirements))}
	ready := true
	for _, requirement := range step.Requirements {
		projection := masteryByTarget[domain.TargetIdentity(requirement.Target)]
		decision := resolveRequirement(domain.PracticeLearningRequirement{
			ID: requirement.ID, Target: requirement.Target, Policy: requirement.Policy, MasteryThreshold: requirement.MasteryThreshold,
		}, projection, policy.MasterySkipConfidence)
		state.Items = append(state.Items, struct {
			ID         string              `json:"id"`
			Target     domain.TargetRef    `json:"target"`
			State      domain.MasteryState `json:"state"`
			Score      float64             `json:"mastery_score"`
			Confidence float64             `json:"confidence"`
			Policy     string              `json:"mastery_policy_version"`
			Decision   string              `json:"decision"`
			Blocking   bool                `json:"blocking"`
		}{requirement.ID, projection.Target, projection.State, projection.MasteryScore, projection.Confidence,
			projection.PolicyVersion, string(decision.Decision), decision.Blocking})
		if decision.Blocking {
			ready = false
		}
	}
	learnerStateDigest, err := digestJSON(state)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.PracticeLearningReadinessReceiptV1{}, false, err
	}
	observedAt := resolver.Clock.Now().UTC()
	decision := domain.PracticeReadinessNotReady
	if ready {
		decision = domain.PracticeReadinessReady
	}
	receipt := domain.PracticeLearningReadinessReceiptV1{
		Schema:         domain.PracticeLearningReadinessReceiptSchemaV1,
		ID:             uuid.NewSHA1(uuid.NameSpaceOID, []byte("practice-readiness\x00"+idempotencyKey+"\x00"+requestHash)).String(),
		TaskInstanceID: route.TaskInstanceID, StudentID: route.StudentID, TaskRevisionID: route.TaskRevisionID,
		TaskRevisionDigest: route.TaskRevisionDigest, RouteID: route.ID, RouteDigest: route.RouteDigest,
		StepID: step.StepID, Decision: decision, LearnerStateDigest: learnerStateDigest,
		MasteryPolicy: domain.StudentMasteryPolicyVersion, ObservedAt: observedAt,
	}
	if !domain.ValidPracticeLearningReadinessReceipt(receipt) {
		return domain.PracticeLearningReadinessReceiptV1{}, false, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	stored, created, err := resolver.Readiness.EnsureReadiness(ctx, domain.PracticeLearningReadinessRecord{
		IdempotencyKey: idempotencyKey, RequestHash: requestHash, Receipt: receipt,
	})
	if err != nil {
		return domain.PracticeLearningReadinessReceiptV1{}, false, err
	}
	if stored.RequestHash != requestHash || stored.IdempotencyKey != idempotencyKey {
		return domain.PracticeLearningReadinessReceiptV1{}, false, domain.ErrConflict
	}
	return stored.Receipt, created, nil
}

func validUUID(value string) bool {
	parsed, err := uuid.Parse(value)
	return err == nil && parsed.String() == value
}

func (resolver Resolver) Resolve(
	ctx context.Context,
	idempotencyKey string,
	input domain.PracticeLearningRouteRequestV1,
) (domain.PracticeLearningRoute, bool, error) {
	if resolver.Routes == nil || resolver.Catalog == nil || resolver.Students == nil || resolver.Policies == nil || resolver.Clock == nil {
		return domain.PracticeLearningRoute{}, false, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	normalized, err := domain.NormalizePracticeLearningRouteRequest(input)
	if err != nil || strings.TrimSpace(idempotencyKey) != normalized.TaskInstanceID {
		return domain.PracticeLearningRoute{}, false, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	requestHash, err := digestJSON(normalized)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.PracticeLearningRoute{}, false, err
	}
	existing, err := resolver.Routes.GetByTaskInstance(ctx, normalized.TaskInstanceID)
	switch {
	case err == nil:
		if existing.RequestHash != requestHash || existing.IdempotencyKey != idempotencyKey {
			return domain.PracticeLearningRoute{}, false, domain.ErrConflict
		}
		return existing.Route, false, nil
	case !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound):
		return domain.PracticeLearningRoute{}, false, err
	}

	policy, err := resolver.Policies.GetActivePolicyBundle(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.PracticeLearningRoute{}, false, err
	}
	policy, err = domain.NormalizePolicyBundle(policy)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.PracticeLearningRoute{}, false, err
	}
	strategies, err := resolver.Strategies.Select(policy.PedagogyStrategies, pedagogy.LessonContext{})
	if err != nil || len(strategies) == 0 {
		return domain.PracticeLearningRoute{}, false, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	targets := uniqueRouteTargets(normalized.Steps)
	definitions, err := resolver.Catalog.ResolveDefinitions(ctx, targets)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.PracticeLearningRoute{}, false, err
	}
	definitionByTarget, err := indexDefinitions(targets, definitions)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.PracticeLearningRoute{}, false, err
	}
	mastery, err := resolver.queryMastery(ctx, normalized.StudentID, targets)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.PracticeLearningRoute{}, false, err
	}
	masteryByTarget, err := indexRouteMastery(targets, mastery)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.PracticeLearningRoute{}, false, err
	}

	route := domain.PracticeLearningRoute{
		Schema:         domain.PracticeLearningRouteSchemaV1,
		ID:             uuid.NewSHA1(uuid.NameSpaceOID, []byte(normalized.TaskInstanceID+"\x00"+requestHash)).String(),
		TaskInstanceID: normalized.TaskInstanceID, TaskRevisionID: normalized.TaskRevisionID,
		TaskRevisionDigest: normalized.TaskRevisionDigest, StudentID: normalized.StudentID,
		Locale: normalized.Locale, PlannerVersion: policy.PlannerVersion,
		Steps: make([]domain.PracticeLearningRouteStep, len(normalized.Steps)), CreatedAt: resolver.Clock.Now().UTC(),
	}
	for stepIndex, step := range normalized.Steps {
		resolvedStep := domain.PracticeLearningRouteStep{StepID: step.StepID, Ready: true, Requirements: make([]domain.ResolvedLearningRequirement, len(step.Requirements))}
		for requirementIndex, requirement := range step.Requirements {
			projection := masteryByTarget[domain.TargetIdentity(requirement.Target)]
			resolved := resolveRequirement(requirement, projection, policy.MasterySkipConfidence)
			if resolved.Decision != domain.RequirementSatisfied {
				definition := definitionByTarget[domain.TargetIdentity(requirement.Target)]
				material, materialErr := buildMaterialRef(definition.Ref, normalized.Locale, policy, strategies)
				if materialErr != nil {
					return domain.PracticeLearningRoute{}, false, materialErr
				}
				resolved.Material = &material
			}
			if resolved.Blocking {
				resolvedStep.Ready = false
			}
			resolvedStep.Requirements[requirementIndex] = resolved
		}
		route.Steps[stepIndex] = resolvedStep
	}
	route.RouteDigest, err = routeDigest(route)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.PracticeLearningRoute{}, false, err
	}
	record := domain.PracticeLearningRouteRecord{IdempotencyKey: idempotencyKey, RequestHash: requestHash, Route: route}
	stored, created, err := resolver.Routes.Ensure(ctx, record)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.PracticeLearningRoute{}, false, err
	}
	if stored.RequestHash != requestHash || stored.IdempotencyKey != idempotencyKey {
		return domain.PracticeLearningRoute{}, false, domain.ErrConflict
	}
	return stored.Route, created, nil
}

func (resolver Resolver) queryMastery(ctx context.Context, studentID string, targets []domain.TargetRef) ([]domain.TargetMastery, error) {
	result := make([]domain.TargetMastery, 0, len(targets))
	for start := 0; start < len(targets); start += 100 {
		end := start + 100
		if end > len(targets) {
			end = len(targets)
		}
		batch, err := resolver.Students.QueryMastery(ctx, studentID, targets[start:end])
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		result = append(result, batch...)
	}
	return result, nil
}

func uniqueRouteTargets(steps []domain.PracticeLearningStepInput) []domain.TargetRef {
	seen := make(map[string]struct{})
	result := make([]domain.TargetRef, 0)
	for _, step := range steps {
		for _, requirement := range step.Requirements {
			identity := domain.TargetIdentity(requirement.Target)
			if _, exists := seen[identity]; exists {
				continue
			}
			seen[identity] = struct{}{}
			result = append(result, requirement.Target)
		}
	}
	return result
}

func indexDefinitions(targets []domain.TargetRef, definitions []domain.LearningTargetDefinition) (map[string]domain.LearningTargetDefinition, error) {
	expected := make(map[string]struct{}, len(targets))
	for _, target := range targets {
		expected[domain.TargetIdentity(target)] = struct{}{}
	}
	result := make(map[string]domain.LearningTargetDefinition, len(definitions))
	for _, definition := range definitions {
		ref, err := domain.NormalizeTargetRef(definition.Ref)
		prerequisites, prerequisitesErr := domain.NormalizeTargetRefs(definition.Prerequisites)
		definition.Title = strings.TrimSpace(definition.Title)
		definition.Description = strings.TrimSpace(definition.Description)
		identity := domain.TargetIdentity(ref)
		if err != nil || prerequisitesErr != nil || definition.Title == "" || len(definition.Title) > 255 {
			return nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		if _, requested := expected[identity]; !requested {
			return nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		if _, duplicate := result[identity]; duplicate {
			return nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		definition.Ref = ref
		definition.Prerequisites = prerequisites
		result[identity] = definition
	}
	if len(result) != len(expected) {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return result, nil
}

func indexRouteMastery(targets []domain.TargetRef, mastery []domain.TargetMastery) (map[string]domain.TargetMastery, error) {
	expected := make(map[string]struct{}, len(targets))
	for _, target := range targets {
		expected[domain.TargetIdentity(target)] = struct{}{}
	}
	result := make(map[string]domain.TargetMastery, len(mastery))
	for _, item := range mastery {
		normalized, err := domain.NormalizeTargetMastery(item)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		identity := domain.TargetIdentity(normalized.Target)
		if _, requested := expected[identity]; !requested {
			return nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		if _, duplicate := result[identity]; duplicate {
			return nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		result[identity] = normalized
	}
	if len(result) != len(expected) {
		return nil, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return result, nil
}

func resolveRequirement(requirement domain.PracticeLearningRequirement, mastery domain.TargetMastery, minimumConfidence float64) domain.ResolvedLearningRequirement {
	result := domain.ResolvedLearningRequirement{
		ID: requirement.ID, Target: requirement.Target, Policy: requirement.Policy,
		MasteryThreshold: requirement.MasteryThreshold, MasteryPolicyVersion: mastery.PolicyVersion,
	}
	if mastery.State == domain.MasteryMastered && mastery.MasteryScore >= requirement.MasteryThreshold && mastery.Confidence >= minimumConfidence {
		result.Decision = domain.RequirementSatisfied
		result.DecisionReason = "objective_mastery_satisfies_threshold"
		return result
	}
	switch requirement.Policy {
	case domain.RequirementPolicyRequired:
		result.Decision, result.DecisionReason, result.Blocking = domain.RequirementLearn, "required_gap", true
	case domain.RequirementPolicyRecommended:
		result.Decision, result.DecisionReason = domain.RequirementRecommend, "recommended_gap"
	case domain.RequirementPolicyOptional:
		result.Decision, result.DecisionReason = domain.RequirementOptional, "optional_gap"
	case domain.RequirementPolicyAdaptive:
		result.Decision, result.DecisionReason = domain.RequirementChallengeOrLearn, "adaptive_gap_requires_challenge_or_material"
		result.Blocking, result.ChallengeOutAllowed = true, true
	}
	return result
}

func buildMaterialRef(target domain.TargetRef, locale string, policy domain.PolicyBundle, strategies []domain.PedagogyStrategyRef) (domain.LearningMaterialRef, error) {
	identity := struct {
		FingerprintVersion string                       `json:"fingerprint_version"`
		Target             domain.TargetRef             `json:"target"`
		Locale             string                       `json:"locale"`
		PlannerVersion     string                       `json:"planner_version"`
		PedagogyProfile    string                       `json:"pedagogy_profile"`
		PresentationStyle  string                       `json:"presentation_style"`
		GenerationPolicy   string                       `json:"generation_policy"`
		Strategies         []domain.PedagogyStrategyRef `json:"pedagogy_strategies"`
	}{domain.PracticeMaterialFingerprintVersion, target, locale, policy.PlannerVersion, policy.PedagogyProfile, policy.PresentationStyle, policy.GenerationPolicy, strategies}
	payload, err := json.Marshal(identity)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.LearningMaterialRef{}, err
	}
	digest := sha256.Sum256(payload)
	key := hex.EncodeToString(digest[:])
	return domain.LearningMaterialRef{
		Key: key, GenerationKey: uuid.NewSHA1(uuid.NameSpaceOID, []byte("practice-material\x00"+key)).String(),
		FingerprintVersion: domain.PracticeMaterialFingerprintVersion, Target: target, Locale: locale,
		PlannerVersion: policy.PlannerVersion, PedagogyProfile: policy.PedagogyProfile,
		PresentationStyle: policy.PresentationStyle, GenerationPolicy: policy.GenerationPolicy,
		PedagogyStrategies: append([]domain.PedagogyStrategyRef(nil), strategies...),
	}, nil
}

func routeDigest(route domain.PracticeLearningRoute) (string, error) {
	copy := route
	copy.RouteDigest = ""
	copy.CreatedAt = time.Time{}
	return digestJSON(copy)
}

func digestJSON(value any) (string, error) {
	payload, err := json.Marshal(value)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	digest := sha256.Sum256(payload)
	return "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(digest[:]), nil
}
